meta.name: image-to-code
meta.description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计图转化为精确的网站代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从设计图生成高质量网页代码
copy.tagline_en: Convert design images into precise website code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality website code from design images

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先自己生成网站设计图，仔细分析图片，再写出匹配的前端代码。它优先为每个区域生成独立大图，避免小图或裁剪旧图。
howto.when: 当你要求设计视觉重要的网站（如首页、营销页、作品集）时触发。Claude 会先出图再编码。

say.text: 帮我设计一个高端 SaaS 着陆页的 Hero 区域。
say.note: Claude 会先生成 Hero 设计图，分析后写出代码。

say.text: 为我的作品集网站生成 3 个不同区域的参考图。
say.note: Claude 会为每个区域单独生成大图，再实现前端。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first generates its own design images, deeply analyzes them, then implements frontend code to match. It prefers large, section-specific images over tiny compressed boards and avoids cropping old images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a visually important website design (e.g., hero section, landing page, portfolio). Claude will generate images first, then code.

say_en.text: Design a premium SaaS landing page hero section.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a hero design image first, then implement it.

say_en.text: Generate 3 reference images for my portfolio site sections.
say_en.note: Claude will create separate large images per section, then code.
